rejected.quote: I still think Milwaukee can finally slay the dragon. That series price is pretty enticing plus a dollar thirty for the number one overall seed.
rejected.edge: This is a better overall club than what the Dodgers swept away last year.
rejected.reason: The Brewers have faced adversity and are a stronger team than last year's Dodgers.
rejected.description: Brewers +130 to win series against Dodgers.
